text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s09.e02","problem":"The 'Set up Computer' title is too wide (117x17 vs want 111x16) and sits 1px high. The mock's font weight and size are a bit larger, so it crowds the '0/3' counter, which is tight against it. In the real screen there is a visible gap.","fix":"Use font-size 15px with weight 500 (not 600) and letter-spacing 0. Set the box to x=55.2, y=85.7, w=111, h=16, line-height 16px. Give '0/3' a left margin of about 8px so it starts at x≈174 as on the real screen."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The hero card art (the 'Start something new' background, about x16-395, y277-822) is very different from the real one. The real one has a crystal ball on green moss, with glowing cyan particle waves on a near-black background. The mock has a blurry olive sphere, a dotted halftone grid and flat dark bands. This is the largest heatmap error on the screen.","fix":"Rebuild the background as a near-black (#0b0908) top, with a cyan/teal (#5fb8c0) speckled wave band across y≈340-560 sloping slightly upward to the right. Add a glass sphere about 135px wide centered at x≈218, y≈540, with mossy green (#6b7a3a) texture in its upper half and a dark lower half. Put a moss ground gradient at y≈570-680 fading to black at the bottom. Remove the regular dot grid."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The card's subtitle wraps differently. The real text breaks after 'curiosity' ('...new world of curiosity / and knowledge'), while the mock breaks after 'of' ('...world of / curiosity and knowledge'). The title is also slightly wider than the real one.","fix":"Set the subtitle font-size to 14px with letter-spacing -0.1px, or a max-width of about 350px, so 'curiosity' fits on the first line. Reduce the serif title from about 24px to 23px so it ends at x≈213."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The left menu icons (Projects, Artifacts, Connectors) and the settings gear are heavier and differently drawn than the real thin-outline icons. The gear is filled solid, while the real one is an outline. The row labels are also about 1px off horizontally.","fix":"Draw the icons as 1.5px-stroke outline SVGs in #1a1a1a with no fill, 20px, centered at x≈28. Make the gear an outline 22px icon. Shift the label text left by 1px so it starts at x=52."},{"element_id":"s09","problem":"The real checklist card has a soft glossy teal-to-white gradient and a lighter body text tone. The mock's card is more uniform, with a harder teal blob at the top right. The bottom composer in the real screen has a soft blurred teal glow border, while the mock has a flat rounded white/gray box with a thin outline.","fix":"Make the card gradient go from #e6f2f4 at the top left to #eef5f6 at the bottom, with a soft teal (#b8d8db) radial glow at the top right, blurred about 30px. Give the composer box a background of #e9e5df plus a 0 0 14px rgba(150,190,190,.35) glow, and remove the hard 1px border."},{"element_id":"s09","problem":"The dashed circles on the checklist rows are drawn in a heavier style than the real ones, which are thin dotted circles. The row text is about 1px higher than on the real screen. The header text, the description text and the placeholder 'Do anything...' also differ slightly in glyph position.","fix":"Draw the row circles as 1px dotted #9aa (dasharray 1.5 2.5) with an 18px diameter. Move the row labels down 1px so their baselines match (Connect your apps at y≈182, Start your first task at y≈222, Turn on notifications at y≈262). Keep the description at 14.5px."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"On the focused-keyboard screens (s02 and s08) the floating side toolbar's active enter button is drawn slightly larger, at about 48px, than the real button at about 44px. The backspace icon also renders as a filled red block in the heatmap, so it is drawn differently from the real outline icon.","fix":"Set the enter button highlight to 44x44 at x=14, y=373, in #dde5fb. Draw the backspace icon as a 1.6px outline with the x inside, not filled, 24px wide, centered at x=36, y=345. Apply the same to s08."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The top bar's tab labels ('Search', 'Computer') and the header buttons (profile, doc) are offset by 1-2px horizontally and vertically. The mock is 1px higher, and the labels sit about 2px to the right. Also the 'Ask anything...' placeholder is about 1-2px wider than the real one.","fix":"Move the tab labels and icons 1px down and 2px left so 'Search' starts at x≈130 and 'Computer' at x≈250. Set the header circle buttons to 46px with the center at y=30. Reduce the placeholder font-size by 0.3px, to 15.5px, so it ends at x≈135."}],"summary":"Element placement is nearly perfect (only s09.e02 is off, by 1px in height and 6px in width), so the remaining loss is visual. The Library hero art is the biggest gap by far, followed by small text metric and weight differences and the composer/card glow styling. This round should fix the s03 hero art and text wrap, then tune the title and icon weights and the focus toolbar sizing.."}
